name: Data Atlas

approval.notes: New proposed visual grammar. Canonical identity is approved, but this creative style has not been reviewed or approved by the user.

description: Evidence-led information design: numerical anchors, comparison matrices, timelines and modular diagram grids. A navigable information map, not an editorial-photo campaign.

source_of_truth.comment: Asya'da Eğitim has approved identity assets but no complete approved brand-system.md. These campaign choices are review-only.

hard_locks.identity: Exact pre-approved V-01 identity only; never reconstruct, redraw, typeset or transform a canonical lockup.

lockup_preference.interior: H-02/dark or P-01/dark on paper; use color-matched canonical light variant for ink/red.

hard_locks.typeface: Jost (campaign production family; not a new canonical brand typography approval)
hard_locks.copy: Preserve approved Turkish copy, official slogan and CTA exactly; no generated logo/wordmark text.
hard_locks.source: Editable HTML/CSS/SVG and actual browser PNG render; optional AI only as separately composited non-text, non-logo imagery.

soft_constants: Lead with a factual information architecture: numbered steps, comparisons, structured values, timeline or map modules.
Use Jost headline hierarchy and strong proportional grids; every key number has units and context.
Photo is optional evidence, never a decorative substitute for a chart or original source.
Vary information structures across the sequence: overview, proof, comparison and conclusion invitation.
Use canonical paper/red/ink palette; bright data markers remain functional accents, not new brand colors.

color_behavior.default_guideline_for_five_slides: Use paper for data overview and at least two other slides; reserve ink/red for section hierarchy, evidence or crucial contrast.
color_behavior.contrast_rule: Legends, metrics and labels must remain accessible; canonical logo variant chosen to match background.
color_behavior.variation_rule: Choose background and annotation rhythm per entire sequence, with red mainly as signposting.

layout_grammar.sequence_rule: Use a different information architecture in overview, comparison and evidence pages; no repeated spreadsheet-like template; data hierarchy remains consistent.
layout_grammar.text_fit: Keep numbers, measures, legends and legal qualifications readable at mobile scale. Never invent figures.
layout_grammar.media: Diagrams, charts and information graphics must use provided or verified numbers. Photos require provenance.
anti_patterns: same big percentage card in every slide
pretending a schematic is real data

evidence_focus.description: Which kind of evidence receives the largest visual role.

content_density.description: How much verified information is displayed per slide; never compromise readability.

cover_device.description: A cover that communicates structured information.

media_role.description: Verified media role, not permission to invent sources.

metrics-overview.label: Metrik atlası
metrics-overview.summary: Number-led overview, modular grids and comparative evidence.

timeline-path.label: Zaman çizelgesi
timeline-path.summary: Sequential milestones and verified dates anchored on a timeline rail.

comparison-led.label: Karşılaştırma panosu
comparison-led.summary: Side-by-side differences, verified dimensions and compact ranking.

required_checks: brand identity and chosen complete SVG lockup hashes verified against canonical manifest
actual HTML/CSS/SVG source preserved and Chromium/Playwright PNG raster verified at target size
legible Turkish copy, typography, contrast, line-wrap and logo clearspace checked on all slides
selected style's distinctive grammar and per-slide visual variety checked in a real render
brand-identity and creative human approvals remain distinct; no automatic publishing

evaluation.method: Compare same brief rendered in registered style families; check grammar distinction and shared approved identity.

preview_quality_contract.source_preference: Use verified assets and current original briefs. Historical candidate posts are not evidence this style was approved.

identity_gate.note: Complete outlined paths must be byte-for-byte identical to the canonical SVG record; brand name must not be a substitute HTML text block.

density_and_layout_gate.logo_positions: Can vary across safe, contrast-appropriate placements; each slide preserves clearspace.
density_and_layout_gate.image_usage: No misleading graphs, invented statistics or decorative charts; visible data sources and units required.
density_and_layout_gate.composition: Diagram/grid architecture distinct from Editorial Campaign: numeric anchors, comparison blocks, reading order and evidence hierarchy.
density_and_layout_gate.visual_inspection: Compare full-page sequences at mobile scale against the existing campaign exemplars; check visual density and content legibility, not palette alone.

test_acceptance: All slides render at 1080 × 1350 from genuinely editable HTML/CSS/SVG.
Every slide uses exact approved SHA-256 verified canonical complete lockup.
The selected style differs compositionally from other registered families, not only by color.
Typography, contrast, safe area, asset provenance and responsive readability pass human review.
No creative or social-media publication approval is inferred.
